alerts.title: CMS — 48-Hour SOA Waiting Period ELIMINATED · Effective Oct 1, 2026
alerts.body: CMS finalized the CY2027 Final Rule removing the mandatory 48-hour waiting period between obtaining a Scope of Appointment (SOA) and conducting a personal marketing appointment. Same-day appointments are now permitted beginning October 1, 2026 for Plan Year 2027 enrollments. Key points: SOA is still required before every appointment. Electronic signatures and audio/video recordings are accepted. SOAs remain valid 12 months if product scope doesn't change. New SOA required when adding products outside original scope. Source: CMS 42 CFR 422.2264(c)(3) and 423.2264(c)(3) — YourFMO Compliance Bulletin.

alerts.title: UHC — UHealth Network Extended to Dec 31, 2026 (Was Sept 1)
alerts.body: UnitedHealthcare has extended UHealth network access through December 31, 2026 for Preferred Care Network members. The Sept 1 end date no longer applies. However, UHealth will be OUT OF NETWORK beginning January 1, 2027. Members on Preferred Care Network will retain access to: Baptist Health Medical Group Physicians, HCA Florida Mercy Hospital, Memorial Healthcare System, and Mount Sinai Medical Center of Florida. AEP (Oct 15 – Dec 7) is the window to switch — any plan change must happen by Dec 7 for Jan 1 coverage. Source: UHC member communication, Aug 2026.

alerts.body: Florida statewide SEP for Impacts of Winter Weather, Droughts, and Wildfire Risks is renewed through Dec 31, 2026 (incident period Jan 31 – Nov 3). Milton, Helene, Debby, and the May thunderstorms SEPs have ended. Check the SEP Tracker for counties and other states.

alerts.title: CMS Considering MA Auto-Enrollment for New Beneficiaries
alerts.body: Trump administration's CMS is reviewing making Medicare Advantage the default enrollment for newly eligible beneficiaries. If this advances, the AEP sales motion changes fundamentally for Florida agents. No formal rule published yet.

alerts.title: Medicare Advantage Improvement Act of 2026 Moving in Congress
alerts.body: Bipartisan HR 8375 / S 4384 would require MA plans to follow traditional Medicare's medical necessity standards and ban algorithmic auto-denials. Track committee markup over the next 30-60 days.

alerts.title: Elevance / Anthem MA Enrollment Suspension Still Active
alerts.body: CMS sanction took effect March 31, 2026. Elevance cannot enroll new members until cleared. Clients already enrolled are unaffected. Watch for CMS clearance announcement before AEP 2027 marketing season.
